applications.name: dubinc/dub
applications.gate: Shipped indexing/sync jobs use the write provider once its credential is supplied; PARTNER_SEARCH_READ_ENABLED controls only reads, not indexing (apps/web/lib/api/partners/search/provider.ts:9-19,22-38; apps/web/lib/api/partners/search/sync.ts:36,98).

optional.what: Index reads for partner search, separately from demanded indexing writes
optional.setting: Configuration (1): PARTNER_SEARCH_READ_ENABLED=true replaces false; read provider is separate from write provider (apps/web/lib/api/partners/search/provider.ts:22-38; apps/web/.env.example:32).
